description:
Update an organization

Updates an organization's name, icon, or status. Owner only, and a partial update — pass only the fields to change. Archiving an organization is a status change, not a delete.

iconUrl.description: Replace the org avatar URL directly. Most clients upload via `PUT /orgs/{orgId}/icon` and let the server write this field.

status.description:
The status of the entity.

- `ACTIVE`: The entity is active.

- `ARCHIVED`: The entity is archived.

name: update_org
